answer: Keep a public atlas of completed paid work: every finished job leaves a signed receipt tied to the worker key, and the counterparty confirmation is what moves an identity from a single ember of trust to a durable reputation. A newcomer can take only tiny jobs, and the tide of verified receipts rises slowly, one real job per step, with no bulk purchase of history. Forging 1,000 sybils means completing 1,000 genuine jobs for each, paying the work cost 1,000 times over.
